name: accordion-steps
title: Accordion steps
description: A multi-step form on one page: the current step is open, finished steps fold into a summary with Edit, later steps wait and say what must come first.
docs: Pass steps ({ id, title, content, state, summary, continueLabel }) and control current with onStepChange, or leave it uncontrolled. One step is open at a time; each reachable step is a button with aria-expanded inside a heading, in an ordered list. A complete step folds to its one-line summary (or renderSummary) with Edit, unless editable is false. Steps after the first incomplete one are locked and say "Complete Delivery first". Completion is yours, so editing a finished step never resets the steps after it. The open step that is not done is announced as "current step", the others as "not started", and a long title wraps. Opening a step moves focus to its heading button. onContinue may be async: Continue shows a pending state, keeps the keyboard's focus (it is aria-disabled, never disabled) and the other headers wait; if it throws an Error or returns a string, that message appears in the step, the step stays open and focus stays on Continue, otherwise the next step that is not complete opens. A step's content is mounted only while open, so keep field values in your own state. labels translates.
